behavior.candidate_card: one readable card with both questionnaire answers shown as question then answer; separate questionnaire files are not created
behavior.operator_link: one common folder link per candidate; folder name is candidate name plus the Test 1 completion date, when the folder is created
behavior.tests: test 1 answers are stored in an A4-like CSV table with five side-by-side blocks of 40 questions and + / М / − marks; ready result graphs are added later
behavior.timeline: candidate link, group join, questionnaire completion, test keyword, test completion, and total elapsed time
